title: ADR-066 — Generative Recoil: reverse-listen a session, compose instance → class → invariant
gate: recoil is bidirectional (audit + generative); instance=frozen live artifact, class=mechanized stamp, invariant=never-relearn rules; rule of three gates generalization; dots connect backward only. Falsifiable: next PRL page costs a spec, not a session. Oracle-allocated. Recorded 2026-08-19.

title: ADR-067 — Cross-subject comparative recoil: independently-derived beats corroborated across counterparts
gate: cross-counterpart convergence of independently-scored beat shapes is itself a receipt-worthy signal (instrument finds transferable pattern, not overfit); stays internal, never surfaced to counterparts. Number confirmed clean by oracle audit 2026-08-23. Recorded 2026-08-19.

Invariant print of the ADR-066 ladder (wing → teardown-page-factory → matrix). Oracle-allocated (counter reconciled 65→67 first). Recorded 2026-08-23.
